title: Dermis STATS (wire schema v1.0)
description: Payload of message 0x02, sent once per second while streaming. Counters are cumulative since boot. Unknown keys must be ignored.

tx_dropped.description: Frames produced but not sent because the USB buffer was full.

rate_hz.description: Frames produced over the last second.

acq_us_max.description: Longest trigger-to-last-read time over the last second.

period_us_max.description: Longest time between two triggers over the last second.

mag_err.description: Invalid mag records per channel since boot.

rx_bad_packets.description: Host commands rejected (COBS, CRC, length or version).

usb_tx_free_min.description: Lowest free space seen in the USB TX buffer over the last second.
